decisions.reason: As a small accessory with limited strategic importance and lower sunk cost, two years without visible market presence make it easier for management to stop justifying continued support.

This box car trailer series is close to the firm's core business and likely absorbed meaningful development effort, so escalation of commitment still favors retention despite the lack of recent visibility.
The car transporter trailer line fits the firm's production know-how and growth direction, so management would tend to interpret weak signs as temporary and continue it.
A low-bed trailer series is a central transport product with substantial sunk cost and strategic fit, which makes withdrawal less likely even after a quieter period.
Although related to the trailer offering, the high trailer cover series is less core than a full trailer line and its absence from recent website evidence weakens the case for continued commitment.
As another core box car trailer series, it benefits from prior public commitment and investment, though overlap and missing recent visibility raise the chance of portfolio consolidation.
